description: Formats a text string from an input pattern, substituting {} placeholders with input values. Output is deferred until the pattern and all required values have been received, preventing incomplete messages.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.description: Format pattern string. Use {} as a placeholder for each input value in order (e.g. "Temperature: {} C, Humidity: {} %"). Can be provided by a String constant block.

inputs.name: Value 1
inputs.description: First value to substitute into the pattern.

inputs.name: Value 2
inputs.description: Second value to substitute into the pattern.

inputs.name: Value 3
inputs.description: Third value to substitute into the pattern.

inputs.name: Value 4
inputs.description: Fourth value to substitute into the pattern.

outputs.name: Text
outputs.description: The formatted text string with placeholders replaced by input values.

config.name: Trigger on pattern
config.description: When enabled, changing the pattern input triggers output recalculation. When disabled, pattern changes are captured silently.

config.name: Trigger on V1
config.description: When enabled, changing Value 1 triggers output recalculation. When disabled, value changes are captured silently.

config.name: Trigger on V2
config.description: When enabled, changing Value 2 triggers output recalculation. When disabled, value changes are captured silently.

config.name: Trigger on V3
config.description: When enabled, changing Value 3 triggers output recalculation. When disabled, value changes are captured silently.

config.name: Trigger on V4
config.description: When enabled, changing Value 4 triggers output recalculation. When disabled, value changes are captured silently.

state.name: Pattern received
state.description: Tracks whether the pattern input has been received at least once.

state.name: Value 1 received
state.description: Tracks whether the v1 input has been received at least once.

state.name: Value 2 received
state.description: Tracks whether the v2 input has been received at least once.

state.name: Value 3 received
state.description: Tracks whether the v3 input has been received at least once.

state.name: Value 4 received
state.description: Tracks whether the v4 input has been received at least once.
